title: Carathéodory, the Cantor set and non-measurable sets
summary: The Carathéodory criterion for measurability; the Cantor set as an uncountable null set; Lebesgue measurable sets that are not Borel; invariance of Lebesgue measure under translations, dilations and rotations; the construction of a non-measurable set.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 8–9 of the 18.125 notes.

preparation.description: Read lecture 8: the Carathéodory criterion, the Cantor set, and the existence of Lebesgue measurable sets that are not Borel.
Read lecture 9: invariance under translations and dilations, a non-measurable set, invariance under rotations.
